env:
  CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: 4
  RUST_TEST_THREADS: 2
  BARCA_POOL_SIZE: 2
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04-16
    timeout-minutes: 40

      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - variant: baseline
            sha: 63a5ed347d3bbdcbcab634b2736f7800823a37c5
          - variant: current
            sha: ec7572fefb525d68ccd78a35b3b6e48d7e8dbf69

      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Extract immutable source

          SHA: ${{ matrix.sha }}

          mkdir source
          git archive "$SHA" | tar -x -C source
          git rev-parse "$SHA" > source-revision.txt
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        id: ui-dist
        with:
          path: source/ui/dist
          key: ui-dist-v1-${{ hashFiles('source/ui/**') }}
      - if: steps.ui-dist.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          package_json_file: source/ui/package.json
      - if: steps.ui-dist.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - if: steps.ui-dist.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        run: |
          pnpm --dir source/ui install --frozen-lockfile
          pnpm --dir source/ui build
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.14'
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v6
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Build exact revision with CI profile
        working-directory: source
        env:
          CARGO_TARGET_DIR: target-local
          CARGO_INCREMENTAL: 1
        run: |
          rustc -Vv > toolchain.txt
          python3 --version >> toolchain.txt
          uname -a >> toolchain.txt
          uvx maturin build --profile fast --out dist-wheel
          cp toolchain.txt ../source-revision.txt dist-wheel/
          sha256sum dist-wheel/*.whl > dist-wheel/wheel-sha256.txt
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: writer-${{ matrix.variant }}
          path: source/dist-wheel/*
          retention-days: 7
          if-no-files-found: error
  measure:
    needs: build
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04-4
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.14'
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v6
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          pattern: writer-*
          path: wheels
      - name: Install both wheels identically
        run: |
          mkdir evidence
          uname -a > evidence/runner.txt
          lscpu >> evidence/runner.txt
          python3 --version >> evidence/runner.txt
          for variant in baseline current; do
            uv venv "venv-$variant"
            uv pip install --python "venv-$variant/bin/python" wheels/writer-$variant/*.whl
            cp wheels/writer-$variant/*.txt evidence/
            sha256sum "venv-$variant/bin/barca" >> evidence/binaries.txt
          done
      - name: Fixed matched sequence, unchanged acceptance gates
        run: |
          failed=0
          index=0
          for variant in baseline current current baseline; do
            index=$((index + 1))
            BARCA_BIN="$PWD/venv-$variant/bin/barca" python3 scripts/perf-gate.py > "evidence/$index-$variant.jsonl" 2> "evidence/$index-$variant.stderr" && status=0 || status=$?

            cat "evidence/$index-$variant.jsonl"
            cat "evidence/$index-$variant.stderr"
            if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then failed=1; fi
          done
          exit "$failed"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: writer-perf-evidence
          path: evidence/*
          retention-days: 7
          if-no-files-found: error

runs.workflow:
name: Writer performance diagnostic
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
env:
  CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: 4
  RUST_TEST_THREADS: 2
  BARCA_POOL_SIZE: 2
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04-16
    timeout-minutes: 40
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - variant: baseline
            sha: 63a5ed347d3bbdcbcab634b2736f7800823a37c5
          - variant: current
            sha: a33c11955d81f4fae18d6e9e3760c268b6b0a5ab
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Extract immutable source
        env:
          SHA: ${{ matrix.sha }}
        run: |
          mkdir source
          git archive "$SHA" | tar -x -C source
          git rev-parse "$SHA" > source-revision.txt
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        id: ui-dist
        with:
          path: source/ui/dist
          key: ui-dist-v1-${{ hashFiles('source/ui/**') }}
      - if: steps.ui-dist.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          package_json_file: source/ui/package.json
      - if: steps.ui-dist.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - if: steps.ui-dist.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        run: |
          pnpm --dir source/ui install --frozen-lockfile
          pnpm --dir source/ui build
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.14'
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v6
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Build exact revision with CI profile
        working-directory: source
        env:
          CARGO_TARGET_DIR: target-local
          CARGO_INCREMENTAL: 1
        run: |
          rustc -Vv > toolchain.txt
          python3 --version >> toolchain.txt
          uname -a >> toolchain.txt
          uvx maturin build --profile fast --out dist-wheel
          if [ "${{ matrix.variant }}" = current ]; then
            cargo test -p barca-service
            cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
          fi
          cp toolchain.txt ../source-revision.txt dist-wheel/
          sha256sum dist-wheel/*.whl > dist-wheel/wheel-sha256.txt
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: writer-${{ matrix.variant }}
          path: source/dist-wheel/*
          retention-days: 7
          if-no-files-found: error
  measure:
    needs: build
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04-4
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.14'
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v6
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          pattern: writer-*
          path: wheels
      - name: Install both wheels identically
        run: |
          mkdir evidence
          uname -a > evidence/runner.txt
          lscpu >> evidence/runner.txt
          python3 --version >> evidence/runner.txt
          for variant in baseline current; do
            uv venv "venv-$variant"
            uv pip install --python "venv-$variant/bin/python" wheels/writer-$variant/*.whl
            mkdir -p "evidence/$variant"
            cp wheels/writer-$variant/*.txt "evidence/$variant/"
            sha256sum "venv-$variant/bin/barca" >> evidence/binaries.txt
          done
      - name: Fixed matched sequence, unchanged acceptance gates
        run: |
          failed=0
          index=0
          for variant in baseline current current baseline; do
            index=$((index + 1))
            BARCA_BIN="$PWD/venv-$variant/bin/barca" python3 scripts/perf-gate.py > "evidence/$index-$variant.jsonl" 2> "evidence/$index-$variant.stderr" && status=0 || status=$?
            echo "$index $variant $status" | tee -a evidence/status.txt
            cat "evidence/$index-$variant.jsonl"
            cat "evidence/$index-$variant.stderr"
            if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then failed=1; fi
          done
          exit "$failed"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: writer-perf-evidence
          path: evidence/
          retention-days: 7
          if-no-files-found: error

  validate:
    needs: build
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04-4
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.14'
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v6
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: writer-current
          path: wheel
      - name: Fresh wheel-only install and doctor controls
        run: |
          uv venv .venv
          uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python wheel/*.whl
          .venv/bin/python -I scripts/check-vendored-doctor.py
          sha256sum .venv/bin/barca
      - name: Python regression coverage against that exact wheel
        run: |
          wheel=$(find wheel -name '*.whl')
          uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python "$wheel[test]"
          tests=$(sed -e '/^#/d' -e '/^$/d' -e 's#^#python/tests/#' scripts/fast-tests.txt)
          .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -n 2 --dist loadscope $tests python/tests/test_version_warnings.py python/tests/test_doctor.py python/tests/test_metadata_compat.py python/tests/test_identity.py python/tests/test_cli_contract.py python/tests/test_docs_examples.py
